## Defect

`fix-debounce`'s lane test is an unanchored substring match over the whole issue body, so an issue that merely MENTIONS the marker is selected:

> `agent-fix ∧ open ∧ body~alert-fp: ∧ ¬agent/queued ∧ ¬agent/linked`

Touches: agents/coordinator/fix-debounce-argo.yaml, agents/replay/

Hand-written by a human, not filed by the responder: the thread carries no `alert-fp:` marker line of its own, and the only occurrence anywhere in the body is the quoted predicate above.
